clips.title: The story
paras: Call to Arms is a Horde military initiative directed by Drum Fel from the outpost of Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. Threatened by an alliance between the local Witherbark forest trolls and Boulderfist ogres, the Horde launches a preemptive campaign against the Witherbark to secure their foothold in the region.

From the fortified sanctuary of Hammerfall, Drum Fel organizes a preemptive military strike against the hostile native powers of the Arathi Highlands. Surrounded by old human ruins and aggressive local factions, the Horde settlement faces an imminent threat from a cooperative pact formed between the indigenous Witherbark forest trolls and the brute Boulderfist ogres. Rather than allowing their enemies to dictate the terms of survival, Drum Fel calls on champions to take the offensive.

The initial offensive focuses south of Hammerfall, targeting the heart of Witherbark territory. The Witherbark have turned their backs on any diplomacy, choosing instead to conspire with the Boulderfist ogres to purge the Horde from the highlands. By culling their specialized axe throwers, headhunters, and witch doctors, Hammerfall seeks to shatter their martial leadership and demonstrate that the Horde is here to stay.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Witherbark trolls and Boulderfist ogres of Arathi are working together to rid us from this land, but we shall not meet our fates at their, or anyone else's, hand. We will slay them and show them that we, too, have a home here.
The trolls turned their backs to us; the ogres would use us for food and bedding if we allowed them to--these things shall not be.
We start our attack on the Witherbark trolls to the south of here. Slay them in droves, and only return when their camps run thick with blood.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The signs of war are upon your garments, and sweat drips from your brow. Good, very good indeed.
